number.description: 1-based position in `rooms`, the same number as in the room id `…:r<number>`.

oneOf.description:
Create the storey, walls and rooms of an empty house from rectangular rooms. Rejected with
house_exists when a house already exists. The result lists each room's number, name and id.

layout.description:
Rectangular rooms on wall centre lines, in millimetres. Repeat the exact coordinate for a shared wall.
Each room must be wider than the thickest wall on both axes. Rooms must not overlap or touch only at a
corner, and walls must not overlap: facing perimeter walls need at least one exterior wall thickness
between their centre lines. Where a wall ends on another wall, the piece of that wall beside the joint
must be at least half the ending wall's thickness long when a thinner wall continues past it.

items.description: A room bounded by the lower-left and upper-right centre-line corners.

name.description: Label shown in the floor plan.

walls.description: Wall thicknesses and height for the whole storey, in millimetres. The height is also the storey height.

oneOf.description: Add a window or door to one wall. The result returns the id of the new opening.

distance.description: Distance along the wall from the reference end to the nearer jamb.

hinge.description: Boundary end whose nearer jamb carries the hinges, independent of the opening's `from`.

opens_to.description: Side of the wall the leaf swings into, looking from the boundary start to the end as for `SideOffsets`: the room on that side, or the exterior when that side has no room.

sill.description: Height of the bottom of the opening above the floor.

oneOf.description: Replace the wall, position, size and fitting of an existing opening. The opening keeps its id.

distance.description: Distance along the wall from the reference end to the nearer jamb.

hinge.description: Boundary end whose nearer jamb carries the hinges, independent of the opening's `from`.

opens_to.description: Side of the wall the leaf swings into, looking from the boundary start to the end as for `SideOffsets`: the room on that side, or the exterior when that side has no room.

sill.description: Height of the bottom of the opening above the floor.

oneOf.description:
Move a wall perpendicular to itself. The result lists the walls that moved, the area of each
room before and after in square metres, and the openings that shifted along their wall.

wall_move.description:
Move a wall perpendicular to itself. Every wall on the same straight line moves with it, and the walls
meeting that line stretch or shrink to stay connected.

distance.description: Millimetres, greater than zero. Never rounded to a grid.

toward.description:
The face of `wall` the line moves toward: the room on that side, or the exterior. Moving toward a room
makes it smaller; moving toward the exterior makes the room on the other side larger.

wall.description: Any wall on the straight line to move.

oneOf.description: Paint one face of one wall. A colour already on that face is replaced.
Remove the colour from one face of one wall.

error.description:
Transport and protocol failures only. Expected route outcomes are 200 bodies with a
`kind` union. BuildFailed means a deterministic build failed unexpectedly.
